title: MCTCG
description: MCTCG is a fully playable trading card game built inside Minecraft. Challenge your friends, climb the matchmaking queue, or practice against AI — all without leaving the game.
body:
How It Works
Each duel is a 1v1 turn-based match. Both players choose a Leader card — your champion on the field with its own HP, ATK, and DEF stats. Build a deck, draw your opening hand, and outlast your opponent by reducing their Leader to 0 HP.

First move is decided the Minecraft way: Shears, Paper, or Cobblestone — a rock-paper-scissors showdown before the match begins.

Card Types
Type	Description
Leader	Your main fighter. Has HP, ATK, and DEF. Losing this means losing the match.
Equipment	Attaches to your Leader to boost stats. Some have durability.
Item	Single-use effects. Discard after use.
Trap	Triggers on your opponent's action.
Special	Unique effects that bend the rules.
Cards can be placed face-down to bluff your opponent, then flipped to activate them.

Rarities
Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary
Legendary cards have animated borders that set them apart on the field
Game Modes
Online Matchmaking — join the queue and get matched with another player
Direct Challenge — challenge a specific player from the in-game player list
VS AI — practice against a built-in AI opponent
Local — pass-and-play on the same machine
Minecrafter Mix
A special card set where real Minecraft content creators become Leader cards — rendered as full 3D player models directly on the card face. The current roster includes:

Wemmbu · FlameFrags · ClownPierce · ParrotX2 · SpokeIsHere · DrDonutt · Dream · TheobaldTheBird · LightFreecs · EggChan

Features
Deck builder with 3 saved deck slots
Card Encyclopedia to browse all available cards
28 base cards + 10 Minecrafter Mix Leaders
